answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
